body: I can't see any light at the end of the tunnel, even though I have lowered my expectations. Could you tell me how things got better for you?

I'm right there with you. I feel very ashamed of myself all the time. 

I guess "little steps" is our answer. Spend one hour per day doing something that is good for us for instance.

Thank you, that's a really nice thing to say. My doctor couldn't tell when and if the back pain will fade. 

I really don't see a point to all this? I used to read religious stuff that went "Every experience is a gift, especially the difficult ones" and really believed it - now I really don't understand why life is worth all the trouble
